title: Add HTML formatting functions to Rust number-utils library
description: Brownfield Rust task: add format_abs_html and format_sign_html functions that render number results as HTML spans.

task_spec.prompt: Add two HTML formatting functions to src/lib.rs. All 3 existing tests must still pass. pub fn format_abs_html(n: i64) -> String — returns {abs_value} — where abs_value is abs(n) pub fn format_sign_html(n: i64) -> String — returns +{n} when n > 0 — returns {n} when n < 0 — returns 0 when n == 0 Do not modify the existing abs function. All 3 existing tests must still pass. Run: cargo test
required_artifacts: format_abs_html returns span with class='abs' containing abs value
format_sign_html returns span with class='positive' for n > 0
format_sign_html returns span with class='negative' for n < 0
format_sign_html returns span with class='zero' for n == 0
followup_prompts: Good. Now handle edge cases: what does the UI show when data is empty, loading, or an error occurs? Add those states and tests.
Run `cargo test` to verify the complete implementation. Fix any failures and confirm all UI states work correctly.
